part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Neighbours
questions: How often do you see your neighbours? [Why/Why not?]
Do you invite your neighbours to your home? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think you are a good neighbour? [Why/Why not?]
Has a neighbour ever helped you? [Why/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe a very difficult task that you succeeded in doing as part of your work or studies.
points: why this task was very difficult
how you worked on this task
part2.closing: and explain how you felt when you had successfully completed this task.

topics.title: Difficult jobs
questions: What are the most difficult jobs that people do?
Why do you think some people choose to do difficult jobs?
Do you agree or disagree that all jobs are difficult sometimes?

topics.title: Personal and career success
questions: How important is it for everyone to have a goal in their personal life?
Is it always necessary to work hard in order to achieve career success?
Do you think that successful people are always happy people?
